ns2:course.label: Intermediate Wolof II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of WLOF 403. Emphasizes ability to engage in reasonably fluent discourse in Wolof, comprehensive knowledge of formal grammar, and ability to read ordinary texts in standard and Dakar Wolof. Participation in language laboratory required. Same as AFST 444. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: WLOF 403.
